CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and its presentation (position set) are given for p0/current/n0, and a separate origin/status field is present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names contents (red/blue) associated with identified referents and gives attribute values (coordinate sets).

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are given separately from the content attribute values, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: Coordinate sets specify how the identified content is presented/organized (spatial pattern) for current referents.
